newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: RESEARCH ALERT-ING Baring cuts Sungmi '97 forecast.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-ING Baring cuts Sungmi '97 forecast.

text.p: The Seoul branch of ING Barings Securities said on Monday it revised down its net profit forecast for Sungmi Telecom to 15.6 billion won in calendar 1997, down from an earlier 23.2 billion won forecast.
The securities house also downgraded its sales forecast for Sungmi Telecom by 17.6 percent, to 198.5 billion won this year.
"The key to this cut in our forecasts is lower expectations for optical transmission systems (OTS)," said an ING Baring report, referring to its earlier prediction as "overly-positive".
The sales of optical transmission systems accounted for 55-65 percent of Sungmi's total sales during the past two years, the report said.
It also revised down its 1998 net profit forecast to 21.2 billion won from its earlier prediction of 32.3 billion.
But ING Baring recommended buying Sungmi Telecom shares, given the attractive share price and value of the company.
